items.text: Among adults referred for cardiac rehabilitation from January 2023 to December 2025, is choosing the remote programme, compared with the centre-based programme, associated with a different proportion completing, using one attendance-equivalent definition and adjusting for referral factors?
items.population: All 1,146 referrals who chose a programme, January 2023 to December 2025
items.outcome: Completion: 12 of 16 sessions or 6 of 8 coaching weeks
items.time: Eight weeks from the first scheduled session
items.setting: Hospital cardiac rehabilitation programme, city and rural catchment

finer: Feasible from existing records in 30 analyst hours; interesting to the board; novel locally; ethical under the consent waiver; relevant to the April 2027 decision.
summary: One PECO question with a single completion definition.
